units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 176a:14">B. Bath. 176ᵃ</cite> <he>אע״פ שק׳ ר״י וכ׳</he> although R. Yishm. praised Ben N. (commended his argument) the practice follows his (R. Yishmael’s) opinion; Y. ib. X, end, 17ᵈ <he>על מדרשו קִילְּסוֹ</he> he commended him for his mode of argumentation.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>ניקח … ונְקַלֵּס להקב״ה</he> let us take up the Lulab and Ethrog and offer praise to the Lord.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 114">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIV</cite> (expl. <he>סֹלּוּ</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 68:5">Ps. LXVIII, 5</cite>) <he>קַלְּסוּ</he> (not <he>קילסו</he>) praise him.

senses.gloss: to tramp or clap (in wailing ceremonies or on joyous occasions), v. קִילּוּס II, 2; M. Kat. 27ᵇ המְקַלֵּס לא יְקַלֵּס וכ׳ the tramper (at mourning ceremonies) must not tramp with a sandal on his foot, but with a shoe, to avoid accident.
קִלֵּס, קִי׳ (denom. of קוֹל, Pales) [to shout, make noise,]
to be praised; to be done honor to by song, clapping &c. Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ כשהיה רואה … מִתְקַלְּסִין (not סון …) whenever he saw a deceased person or a bride honored.
